# Preamble

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
setwd("/Users/jcolado/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/washb-serology/projects/8-washbb-rct/data") #update file path
#---------------------------------------
# load + merge data
#---------------------------------------
d <- read.csv("washb-bangladesh-uptake-public.csv",
              colClasses = c(dataid = "character", clusterid = "character"))

d_tr <- read.csv("washb-bangladesh-tr-public.csv",
                 colClasses = c(clusterid = "character"))

d <- left_join(d, d_tr, by = c("clusterid", "block"))



```




```{r}
#---------------------------------------
# restrict to the 4-arm 2x2 factorial subset
#---------------------------------------
subset_arms <- c("Control", "WSH", "Nutrition", "Nutrition + WSH")
d <- d %>% filter(tr %in% subset_arms)

#---------------------------------------
# define the two factorial margins
#---------------------------------------
d <- d %>%
  mutate(
    wash = case_when(
      tr %in% c("WSH", "Nutrition + WSH")   ~ "WASH",
      tr %in% c("Control", "Nutrition")     ~ "No WASH"),
    nut = case_when(
      tr %in% c("Nutrition", "Nutrition + WSH") ~ "Nutrition",
      tr %in% c("Control", "WSH")               ~ "No Nutrition")
  )

# indicators shown in Table 3
inds <- c("storewat", "freechl", "latseal", "latfeces", "hwss", "rlnsp")

#---------------------------------------
# summarize n (%) for one margin grouping.
# same long-reshape / mean-N-n logic as the
# verified script, but grouped on the margin
# variable instead of `tr`.
#---------------------------------------
summ_margin <- function(data, group_var) {
  data %>%
    select(dataid, clusterid, block, svy,
           group = all_of(group_var), all_of(inds)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(inds),
                 names_to = "indicator", values_to = "value") %>%
    group_by(indicator, group, svy) %>%
    summarize(mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
              N    = sum(!is.na(value)),
              n    = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    # n is meaningless for LNS (rlnsp is % of expected, not binary)
    mutate(n = ifelse(indicator == "rlnsp", NA, n))
}

wash_sum <- summ_margin(d, "wash")
nut_sum  <- summ_margin(d, "nut")
dsum <- bind_rows(wash_sum, nut_sum)

#---------------------------------------
# applicability / blanking rule.
# Chlorine was distributed only to WSH-containing
# arms, so free chlorine is reported only in the
# WASH group (blanked everywhere else, matching the
# paper's convention of blanking control/non-water
# arms). LNS was given only to nutrition-containing
# arms, so it is reported only in the Nutrition group.
# Enrolment freechl/LNS are not measured (N=0
# -> blanks naturally).
#---------------------------------------
dsum <- dsum %>%
  mutate(
    applicable = case_when(
      indicator == "freechl" & group != "WASH"      ~ FALSE,
      #indicator == "rlnsp"   & group != "Nutrition" ~ FALSE,
      TRUE ~ TRUE),
    pct = round(mean * 100),
    cell = case_when(
      !applicable                       ~ "..",
      indicator == "rlnsp" & N == 0     ~ "..",
      indicator == "rlnsp"              ~ paste0(pct, "%"),
      N == 0 | is.nan(mean)             ~ "..",
      TRUE                              ~ paste0(n, "/", N, " (", pct, "%)"))
  )

#---------------------------------------
# assemble the wide table:
#   columns = WASH | No WASH | Nutrition | No Nutrition
#   rows    = indicator x survey round
#---------------------------------------
col_order <- c("WASH", "No WASH", "Nutrition", "No Nutrition")

tab <- dsum %>%
  mutate(svy = factor(svy, levels = c(0, 1, 2),
                      labels = c("Enrollment", "Year 1", "Year 2")),
         indicator = factor(indicator, levels = inds)) %>%
  select(indicator, svy, group, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = cell) %>%
  select(indicator, svy, all_of(col_order)) %>%
  arrange(indicator, svy)

#---------------------------------------
# number of compounds assessed per margin
# group x round, in fraction format num/N (%):
#   num = compounds measured at the round
#   N   = number enrolled in the margin group
#         (= enrolment count), so enrolment = 100%
# (each compound is counted in one WASH group
#  and one Nutrition group)
#---------------------------------------
assessed_margin <- function(group_var) {
  counts <- d %>%
    group_by(group = .data[[group_var]], svy) %>%
    summarize(num = n(), .groups = "drop")
  denom <- counts %>% filter(svy == 0) %>% select(group, N_enr = num)
  counts %>%
    left_join(denom, by = "group") %>%
    mutate(pct  = round(100 * num / N_enr),
           cell = paste0(num, "/", N_enr, " (", pct, "%)"))
}

ncomp <- bind_rows(assessed_margin("wash"), assessed_margin("nut")) %>%
  mutate(svy = factor(svy, levels = c(0, 1, 2),
                      labels = c("Enrollment", "Year 1", "Year 2"))) %>%
  select(group, svy, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = cell) %>%
  select(svy, all_of(col_order))

#---------------------------------------
# indicator labels
#---------------------------------------
indlab <- c(
  storewat = "Stored drinking water",
  freechl  = "Stored drinking water has detectable free chlorine (>0.1 mg/L)",
  latseal  = "Latrine with a functional water seal",
  latfeces = "No visible feces on latrine slab or floor",
  hwss     = "Handwashing location has soap",
  rlnsp    = "LNS sachets consumed (% expected)*"
)


#---------------------------------------
# lead with the compound-count block (the top
# row block of the published Table 3), then the
# indicator rows.
#---------------------------------------
ncomp_out <- ncomp %>%
  mutate(Indicator = "Number of compounds assessed") %>%
  rename(Round = svy) %>%
  select(Indicator, Round, all_of(col_order))

out <- tab %>%
  mutate(indicator = recode(as.character(indicator), !!!indlab)) %>%
  rename(Indicator = indicator, Round = svy)

out <- bind_rows(ncomp_out, out)
```



# Measures of intervention adherence by treatment margin (WASH vs. No WASH, Nutrition vs. No Nutrition) at enrollment, 1-year follow-up, and 2-year follow-up

```{r}

kbl(out,
    align   = c("l", "l", "c", "c", "c", "c"),
    caption = "Bangladesh: intervention adherence by 2×2 factorial margin") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE,
                bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed")) %>%
  # narrow the Indicator column (labels wrap) and give the data columns room.
  # NOTE: column_spec() must run BEFORE collapse_rows(), which rewrites the
  # table's cell structure and would otherwise break column indexing.
  column_spec(1, width = "13em") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "5em") %>%
  column_spec(3:6, width = "7em") %>%
  # merge the repeated Indicator labels so each spans its three rounds
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>%
  footnote(general_title = "",
           general = paste(
             "Data are n (%) or %. '..' = not measured or not interpretable on",
             "this margin. Free chlorine reported for the WASH group only; LNS for",
             "the Nutrition group only (% of expected). Both not measured at enrolment."))
```




# Save and Export
```{r}
#---------------------------------------
# write a flat CSV & Word Doc
# (paths are relative to this .qmd in bangladesh/R,
#  so "../" writes into the bangladesh/ folder)
#---------------------------------------
write.csv(out, "../output/wash-adherence-2x2margin-bangladesh.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Word doc copy: build a flextable and save it.
# save_as_docx() uses the officer backend (writes .docx
# directly, no pandoc needed).
library(flextable)
library(officer)
ft <- flextable(out) %>%
  merge_v(j = "Indicator") %>%
  valign(j = "Indicator", valign = "top") %>%
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") %>%
  width(j = "Indicator", width = 2.2) %>%   # narrow the label column (inches)
  # fit the whole table to the page width so it isn't clipped
  set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1)
save_as_docx(
  ft, path = "../output/wash-adherence-2x2margin-bangladesh.docx",
  # landscape gives the 6 columns room to breathe
  pr_section = prop_section(page_size = page_size(orient = "landscape"))
)
```
